decisions.reason: The MeetAlfred plan upgrade does not change the deferred email campaign's channel, automation mode, platform, scope, or lifecycle.
Although the synchronization uses MeetAlfred and may depend operationally on its integrations, the plan upgrade does not change the required list-transfer behavior or scope.
The accepted MeetAlfred Pro plan does not change the independently specified Zapier Professional subscription or Zapier account setup.
The MeetAlfred subscription choice does not change the silent-lead selection, follow-up list behavior, transfer expectation, or cleanup constraint.
The source decision concerns the MeetAlfred account and does not alter the separate Apollo account setup requirement.
The plan upgrade does not resume or otherwise change the deferred LinkedIn campaign automation requirement.
The MeetAlfred plan selection does not change the Sales Navigator list setup target or scope.
The MeetAlfred subscription change does not affect Apollo email enrichment behavior, synchronization, or delivery latency.
The source decision does not change the Apollo-to-HubSpot contact synchronization systems, mode, data, latency, or scope.
The MeetAlfred plan upgrade does not alter the Sales Navigator-to-Apollo export behavior or platforms.
The MeetAlfred subscription choice is unrelated to creating the campaign domain.
The accepted MeetAlfred plan does not change the HubSpot CRM platform or setup scope.
